In the given question, two equations numbered l and II are given. Solve both equations and mark the appropriate answer.

I. x² − 6x + 8 = 0
II. y² − 4y − 12 = 0
questions.explanation:
Calculation:

I. x2 − 6x + 8 = 0

⇒ x2 − 4x − 2x + 8 = 0

⇒ x(x − 4) − 2(x − 4) = 0

⇒ (x − 2)(x − 4) = 0

⇒ x = 2, 4

II. y2 − 4y − 12 = 0

⇒ y2 − 6y + 2y − 12 = 0

⇒ y(y − 6) + 2(y − 6) = 0

⇒ (y + 2)(y − 6) = 0

⇒ y = −2, 6

2 6 x < y
4 −2 x > y
4 6 x < y

∴ x = y or No definite relation can be established between x and y.

In the given question, two equations numbered l and II are given. Solve both the equations and mark the appropriate answer.

I. x2 + 4x - 21= 0

II. y2 - 5y - 24 = 0

options.text: x = y or relation between x and y can not be established.

questions.explanation:
Given:

I. x2 + 4x - 21= 0

II. y2 - 5y - 24 = 0

Calculation:

From I,

x2 + 4x - 21= 0

⇒ x2 + 7x - 3x - 21= 0

⇒ x(x + 7) - 3(x + 7) = 0

⇒ (x + 7)(x - 3) = 0

Taking,

⇒ (x + 7) = 0 or (x - 3) = 0

⇒ x = -7 or 3

From II,

y2 - 5y - 24 = 0

⇒ y2 - 8y + 3y - 24 = 0

⇒  y(y - 8) + 3(y - 8) = 0

⇒ (y - 8)(y + 3) = 0

Taking,

⇒ (y - 8) = 0 or (y + 3) = 0

⇒ y = 8 or -3

In the following question, two equations are given. You have to solve the equation and mark the answer accordingly.

I. x2 + 11x + 24 = 0

II. y2 + 26y + 69 = 0

options.text: No relation in x and y or x = y

questions.explanation:
Given:

I. x2 + 11x + 24 = 0

II. y2 + 26y + 69 = 0

Calculation:

From I

x2 + 11x + 24 = 0

⇒ x2 + 8x + 3x + 24 = 0

⇒ x(x + 8) + 3(x + 8) = 0

⇒ (x + 8)(x + 3) = 0

⇒ x = -8, -3

From II

y2 + 26y + 69 = 0

⇒ y2 + 23y + 3y + 69 = 0

⇒ y(y + 23) + 3(y + 23) = 0

⇒ (y + 23)(y + 3) = 0

⇒ y = -23, -3

Two equations I and II are given below in question. You have to solve these equations and give the answer.

I. x2 + 9x – 36 = 0

II. y2 – 9y + 20 = 0

options.text: x = y or the relation between x and y can't be established.

questions.explanation:
Given:

I. x2 + 9x - 36 = 0

II. y2 - 9y + 20 = 0

Calculation:

I. x2 + 9x - 36 = 0

⇒ x2 + 12x - 3x + 36 = 0

⇒ x(x + 12) - 3(x + 12)= 0

⇒ (x + 12)(x - 3) = 0

⇒ x = (-12), 3

II. y2 - 9y + 20 = 0

⇒ y2 - 5y - 4y + 20 = 0

⇒ y(y - 5) - 4(y - 5) =0

⇒ (y - 5)(y - 4) = 0

⇒ y = 5, 4
